selection: Combine the already frozen 12-case August 24 quote-anchored sample and the already frozen 8-case August 25-28 quote-anchored sample. Retain all 20 cases in original chronological order; no case, return, target, stop, later high, or missingness result is used to reselect the sample.
question: Holding signal selection, decision quote, entry, size, latency, spread, participation, costs, stop, target and 45-minute horizon fixed, how many exit outcomes change when qualified bid capacity may arrive within 30 seconds rather than 3 seconds after the already latched stop, target or timeout trigger?
exit_rule: The first stop, target or timeout trigger remains latched. Search only for the first subsequent valid bid quote with sufficient displayed size and causal lagged-minute participation within the assigned allowance measured from that trigger. A later rebound cannot replace a stop, and a later target cannot replace a timeout.
primary_metric: Paired reduction in UNKNOWN exit classifications at 30 seconds versus 3 seconds, reported with the full 20-case denominator for every latency/cost scenario.
secondary_metrics: Paired status transition counts for every case and scenario.
Resolved modeled returns by case only; do not average a resolved subset as strategy expectancy.
Full-sample expectancy only if every one of the 20 cases has a modeled return, which is not expected because no-entry and no-decision cases remain in the denominator.
interpretation: This is an exposed development measurement sensitivity selected to reduce known exit-capacity missingness. It cannot select a trading rule, demonstrate profitability, revise discovery accuracy, or serve as independent validation.
